# Library module reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:lib` from the module docs in src/lib. Edit those, not this file. -->

One line per module in `src/lib`, taken from the `@module` doc at the top of each TypeScript file and the `@component` doc at the top of each Svelte component. Hover a module or component in the editor for its full documentation. See [the library architecture](lib-architecture.md) for ownership and the rules between layers.

## Documentation conventions

- **Every module opens with a `/** … @module */` comment**: what it is for, the domain rules it encodes, and worked examples where the rule is subtle. The first paragraph is its summary here.
- **Every Svelte component opens with an `<!-- @component … -->` comment**, shown when hovering the component where it is used, with a usage example where props are not obvious.
- **Exports, props and type members carry `/** … */` docs**, never `//` comments, so editors show them at every use. Prop docs live on the props type. Defaults are stated with `@defaultValue`.
- **`//` comments are for implementation notes** inside function bodies and markup, and for section dividers.
- Long design rationale stays in the module doc next to the code it explains; cross-cutting rules live in `docs/` (for example [strength basis rules](strength-basis-rules.md) and [ILN](iln.md)).

## catalog

Browser-safe package contracts, interpretation, titles and read projections.

| Module                                                                      | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`catalog/cms-billing.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/cms-billing.ts)               | CMS Part B billing format — CMS publishes a quarterly NDC–HCPCS crosswalk for Medicare Part B drugs: which HCPCS code each 11-digit NDC bills under, the code's dosage descriptor, and how many billable units one package holds.                                                        |
| [`catalog/drugs-com.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/drugs-com.ts)                   | Drugs.com addresses for a package — Built, never fetched.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [`catalog/effective-package.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/effective-package.ts)   | Resolving the package a reader sees: provider facts merged across refreshes (known values survive an outage, new facts are accepted), then corrections applied and the values they affect re-derived, then explicit volume corrections.                                                  |
| [`catalog/labeler-ambiguity.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/labeler-ambiguity.ts)   | Labeler submission ambiguities — Labelers routinely submit a number that is true of something other than what the directory field means: the salt's mass where the moiety's belongs, the diluent added where the final volume belongs, the container's capacity where the fill belongs.  |
| [`catalog/labeler-group.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/labeler-group.ts)           | Which company a package is "from", for grouping — Labeler names arrive spelled however each SPL or directory row spelled them: `Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc.`, `TEVA PHARMACEUTICALS INC`, `Teva, Inc.` are one company, and a hierarchy keyed on the raw string splits it three ways. |
| [`catalog/load-target.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/load-target.ts)               | What a formulary item was loaded from — an RxNorm concept, one NDC, or a curated product set — and the id each is keyed by.                                                                                                                                                              |
| [`catalog/ndc-packaging.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/ndc-packaging.ts)           | Packaging description parsing — openFDA's NDC directory describes a package as nested levels joined by " / ", outermost first, each level shaped `<qty> [unit] in 1 <container>` with the package NDC parenthesized:                                                                     |
| [`catalog/ndc.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/ndc.ts)                               | NDC format plumbing — RxNorm hands us normalized 11-digit unhyphenated NDCs (`25021032104`).                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [`catalog/package-facts.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/package-facts.ts)           | Package interpretation: the facts derived from a package's description and label (unit of use, volume, kit parts), and the eligibility ladder (FDA directory → RxNav → SPL) that decides whether it is excluded from a formulary. An outage is never evidence of absence.                |
| [`catalog/package-state.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/package-state.ts)           | Keeping provider facts, review decisions and field overrides apart: the baseline stored from providers, the review choices patched on top of it, and the curated package they produce.                                                                                                   |
| [`catalog/package-text.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/package-text.ts)             | Package text for display: dose forms in pharmacy shorthand (`TAB FC ER`) and package descriptions and product names in readable case.                                                                                                                                                    |
| [`catalog/package-title.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/package-title.ts)           | What a package is called: its RxNorm-style title built from ingredients, strengths, dose form, packaging and brand, the labeler's own product name, and the strength text titles use.                                                                                                    |
| [`catalog/package-unit-label.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/package-unit-label.ts) | Unit-of-sale and unit-of-use labels without volumes (`10 x vial, single dose`, `1 bottle x 90 tablets`, `tablet`).                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [`catalog/package-view.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/package-view.ts)             | The read projection of a package: fallbacks resolved once, so its title and its grouping consume exactly the same facts.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`catalog/review-package.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/review-package.ts)         | The pure field-review merge behind "Reload & reinterpret": selected new facts are taken, and retained corrections are resolved after them.                                                                                                                                               |
| [`catalog/search-relevance.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/search-relevance.ts)     | How well a drug name answers a search, shared by the live RxNav ranking and the local catalog search so both order results the same way.                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`catalog/search-types.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/search-types.ts)             | Result shapes the search API returns, including curated product sets a query names.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`catalog/types.ts`](../src/lib/catalog/types.ts)                           | Browser-safe catalog contracts. Provider adapters and read projections share these shapes; this module must not depend on server modules.                                                                                                                                                |

## labels

Reading SPL labels: sections, ingredients, appearance, routes, reconstitution and dose-form corrections.

| Module                                                                        | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`labels/dose-form-correction.ts`](../src/lib/labels/dose-form-correction.ts) | Correcting a liquid dose form that is really a powder — The FDA NDC directory's `dosage_form` is copied from the SPL's `<formCode>`, and labelers regularly code a constitutable powder as the liquid it becomes.                                                                                  |
| [`labels/dry-fill-volume.ts`](../src/lib/labels/dry-fill-volume.ts)           | What does a dry-fill vial's labeled volume actually mean? — `medication/ingredient-content.ts` establishes that a lyophilized vial's strength denominator is labeler choice, not physics, and keys content equivalence on the mass numerator instead.                                              |
| [`labels/kit-parts.ts`](../src/lib/labels/kit-parts.ts)                       | What is in a kit, and which kit this NDC is — A powder-for-oral-solution kit is two bottles in a carton: the drug, and a drug-free flavored diluent measured to make it up.                                                                                                                        |
| [`labels/label-multidose.ts`](../src/lib/labels/label-multidose.ts)           | Multi-dose resolution from SPL label text — Pass 2 of the ladder, for packages the NDC directory describes only as "VIAL".                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [`labels/label-relevance.ts`](../src/lib/labels/label-relevance.ts)           | Which parts of a shared label are about this NDC — One SPL often covers several products: amoxicillin tablets and its powder for oral suspension, or ceftriaxone's 500 mg, 1 g and 2 g vials.                                                                                                      |
| [`labels/reconstitution-terms.ts`](../src/lib/labels/reconstitution-terms.ts) | Which route, and with what? — A reconstitution instruction is only half an answer without its purpose.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [`labels/reconstitution.ts`](../src/lib/labels/reconstitution.ts)             | Reconstitution tables from SPL labels — RxNorm cannot answer "how do I reconstitute this vial", and the gap is structural rather than a data-quality lapse: RxNorm has no injectable powder dose form at all.                                                                                      |
| [`labels/route-code.ts`](../src/lib/labels/route-code.ts)                     | Two-letter clinical abbreviations for SPL route names, as written on orders (ORAL → PO, SUBCUTANEOUS → SQ).                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [`labels/routes.ts`](../src/lib/labels/routes.ts)                             | Reading routes of administration from product names, dose-form labels and label prose, folded into one route vocabulary.                                                                                                                                                                           |
| [`labels/spl-appearance-text.ts`](../src/lib/labels/spl-appearance-text.ts)   | What the label's prose says the pill looks like — The `<characteristic>` observations $lib/labels/spl-characteristics.ts decodes are a coded summary; the labeler's own sentence in How Supplied or Dosage Forms & Strengths is the original.                                                      |
| [`labels/spl-characteristics.ts`](../src/lib/labels/spl-characteristics.ts)   | What the pill in the bottle looks like — The decoding half of the `<characteristic>` observations $lib/labels/spl-ingredients.ts parses, and the geometry the mockup is drawn from.                                                                                                                |
| [`labels/spl-ingredients.ts`](../src/lib/labels/spl-ingredients.ts)           | What a label says is _in_ the product — The one question no other source in this app can answer.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`labels/spl-sections.ts`](../src/lib/labels/spl-sections.ts)                 | The label's prescribing information, with its shape intact — openFDA's `/drug/label` fields are the SPL sections flattened to one string apiece: subsection titles run into the paragraph before them, list items lose their bullets, and a dosing table becomes a row of numbers with no columns. |
| [`labels/spl-strength-checks.ts`](../src/lib/labels/spl-strength-checks.ts)   | Label strengths that cannot be true as coded — SPL states every strength as a numerator/denominator ratio whose denominator should be the unit of presentation — 1 VIAL, 1 TABLET, 1 mL.                                                                                                           |

## medication

Domain arithmetic and naming: strengths, quantities, rationals, ingredients, moieties and ions.

| Module                                                                                      | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`medication/biosimilar.ts`](../src/lib/medication/biosimilar.ts)                           | Biosimilars are not their reference product — FDA gives every biosimilar a four-letter suffix on its proper name — `adalimumab-adaz`, `insulin glargine-yfgn` — because a biosimilar is highly similar to its reference product, not identical, and is not interchangeable with it unless separately designated.  |
| [`medication/brand-name.ts`](../src/lib/medication/brand-name.ts)                           | Splitting RxNorm's trailing `[Brand]` off a drug name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`medication/brand-tags.ts`](../src/lib/medication/brand-tags.ts)                           | Brand tags on a formulary item: RxNorm brands merged in on load, manual tags added, and RxNorm tags dismissed rather than deleted so reloads respect the dismissal.                                                                                                                                               |
| [`medication/clinical-name.ts`](../src/lib/medication/clinical-name.ts)                     | The shared parser for clinical drug names; source and display adapters decide which forms they can use.                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| [`medication/concept-fill.ts`](../src/lib/medication/concept-fill.ts)                       | Filling package gaps from the formulary concept — Most packages on the formulary have never been enriched, so they carry no ingredients and often only the dose form RxNorm gave their concept ("Oral Tablet") instead of the label's ("TABLET, FILM COATED").                                                    |
| [`medication/dosing-measure.ts`](../src/lib/medication/dosing-measure.ts)                   | Dosing measure for combination products — A combination product has no single strength to dose by.                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [`medication/ingredient-constituents.ts`](../src/lib/medication/ingredient-constituents.ts) | What each label ingredient is made of — A label lists salts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`medication/ingredient-content.ts`](../src/lib/medication/ingredient-content.ts)           | Collection-only mass and dosage-form parsers ported from MedPool — A strength like "12 g/60mL" on a lyophilized vial is not a concentration: the denominator is whatever volume the labeler chose to print, while the numerator is the drug actually in the vial.                                                 |
| [`medication/ingredient-correction.ts`](../src/lib/medication/ingredient-correction.ts)     | Ingredient corrections: one ingredient row as a person says it should read (substance, strength basis, conversion), how it is stored as an override, described, and applied to the package.                                                                                                                       |
| [`medication/ingredient-group.ts`](../src/lib/medication/ingredient-group.ts)               | Which ingredient a product is "of", for grouping — Sources disagree on how to name an active ingredient.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`medication/ingredient-scenarios.ts`](../src/lib/medication/ingredient-scenarios.ts)       | Ingredient scenarios for a formulary item: which combinations of varying ingredients its NDCs come in, and which NDCs remain when a formulary avoids some of them.                                                                                                                                                |
| [`medication/ions.ts`](../src/lib/medication/ions.ts)                                       | Ions as constituents of a salt ingredient. Sources name them inconsistently — GSRS and SPL say `CHLORIDE ION`, `SODIUM CATION`, `CHLORIDE ANION`; label prose says "sodium" — so everything shown to the user goes through here and reads one way: "Sodium ion (Na⁺)", "Chloride ion (Cl⁻)".                      |
| [`medication/pseudo-scd.ts`](../src/lib/medication/pseudo-scd.ts)                           | Pseudo-SCDs for bulk dry fills — RxNorm quantifies a unit-dose dry-fill vial by its content (`vancomycin 1000 MG Injection`) but a pharmacy bulk package by the concentration it is reconstituted to (`vancomycin 100 MG/ML Injectable Solution`).                                                                |
| [`medication/quantified-scd.ts`](../src/lib/medication/quantified-scd.ts)                   | Restating RxNorm's quantity-led SCD names (`4 ML pembrolizumab 25 MG/ML Injection`) by total content (`pembrolizumab 100 MG …`).                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`medication/quantity.ts`](../src/lib/medication/quantity.ts)                               | Typed quantities — What QuantityField reads: a number the way it is said out loud, with or without its unit — "150", "131 11/19", "2500/19 mg/mL", "0.9%", "1.5 g", "250 mg/5 mL", "20,000 UNT/vial".                                                                                                             |
| [`medication/rational.ts`](../src/lib/medication/rational.ts)                               | Exact rational quantities — A concentration is a division, and the ones a pharmacy works with rarely divide evenly: 1.5 g reconstituted to 11.4 mL is 1500/11.4 = 2500/19 mg/mL, a number no decimal writes down.                                                                                                 |
| [`medication/strength-conversion.ts`](../src/lib/medication/strength-conversion.ts)         | Converting a strength between substances by molecular weight — 500 mg of a salt carries less drug than 500 mg of its free base; moving a strength from one measured substance to the other scales it by the ratio of their molecular weights, adjusted for how many units of the first make up one of the second. |
| [`medication/strength-storage.ts`](../src/lib/medication/strength-storage.ts)               | Storage adapter: the common strength grammar in the catalog's numeric column shape.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [`medication/strength-style.ts`](../src/lib/medication/strength-style.ts)                   | Strength display styles — Some ingredients are conventionally stated in special terms: sterile water and sodium chloride as a percentage, epinephrine in local anaesthetics as a ratio.                                                                                                                           |
| [`medication/strength.ts`](../src/lib/medication/strength.ts)                               | The strict decimal strength grammar shared by every strength parser, and the exact identity strengths are compared and classified by.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [`medication/time-release.ts`](../src/lib/medication/time-release.ts)                       | Time-release names: RxNorm's leading release period ("24 HR …") moved behind the release modifier, and user abbreviations ("SR", "XL") swapped in.                                                                                                                                                                |
| [`medication/units.ts`](../src/lib/medication/units.ts)                                     | Unit factors shared by every parser, so no two agree on what "gm" or "µg" means. Keys are lowercase; look units up through `mgPer`/`mlPer`. `quantity.ts` keeps its own exact rational factors for arithmetic.                                                                                                    |

## formulary

Formulary items, hierarchy grouping, equivalence groups and pharmacologic class rules.

| [`formulary/hierarchy.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/hierarchy.ts)                                 | Formulary hierarchy — A formulary view is a list of packages grouped by an ordered list of dimensions the user picks: route class → route → dose form → item → … Each dimension reads one or more values from a row; a row with several values (a combination product's ingredients) repeats under each, and a row with none lands in a "Not specified" bucket rather than disappearing. |

| [`formulary/pharm-class-key.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/pharm-class-key.ts)                     | The key a pharmacologic class rule matches a package by: its active moieties, dose-form group, route and exact strengths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [`formulary/pharm-class-rule-input.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/pharm-class-rule-input.ts)       | Validation for pharmacologic class rule input: class lists normalized, over-long names and malformed ids rejected.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [`formulary/pharm-class-rule-label.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/pharm-class-rule-label.ts)       | A pharmacologic class rule's key in words, e.g. `Lidocaine · Injectable · 20 mg/mL`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [`formulary/pharm-class-rules.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/pharm-class-rules.ts)                 | Resolving pharmacologic classes from rules: which rules match a package, and how the most specific one decides.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`formulary/pharm-class-scope-options.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/pharm-class-scope-options.ts) | The scopes a pharmacologic class rule for a package can take, broadest first: all forms, the dose-form group, each listed route, then the strength.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`formulary/pharm-class-view.ts`](../src/lib/formulary/pharm-class-view.ts)                   | Read-side application of pharmacologic class rules to packages, recording which source classes a rule replaced, added or removed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

| [`curation/property-override-fields.ts`](../src/lib/curation/property-override-fields.ts) | The catalogue of overridable package properties: every override key, how its value is read, checked and applied, the fixed choices it offers, and which fields apply to the whole product or to every package holding the same unit of use. |

| [`imprints/iln-location.ts`](../src/lib/imprints/iln-location.ts)           | ILN location codes: PATH:ROUTE@PLACE.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`imprints/iln-parse.ts`](../src/lib/imprints/iln-parse.ts)                 | Read ILN strings back in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [`imprints/iln-render.ts`](../src/lib/imprints/iln-render.ts)               | From ILN to a drawing — `spl-to-iln` turns SPL's flat imprint string into Imprint Layout Notation: a guess, with confidence, at which face each segment sits on, where the score falls and what it divides.                                                             |
| [`imprints/measured-to-iln.ts`](../src/lib/imprints/measured-to-iln.ts)     | From a measured photo to ILN — `pill-image-analyze` finds each imprint section's box on the label photo.                                                                                                                                                                |

| [`imprints/shapes.ts`](../src/lib/imprints/shapes.ts)                       | Shape definitions used by ILN: the 19 FDA SPL shapes (NCI value set C48557) plus ILN extension shapes, and the per-face direction tag that records which way a directional outline points in the canonical view, e.g. F[TIP@E].                                         |
| [`imprints/spl-to-iln.ts`](../src/lib/imprints/spl-to-iln.ts)               | First-pass conversion of FDA SPL appearance characteristics (SPLCOLOR, SPLSHAPE, SPLSIZE, SPLSCORE, SPLIMPRINT, SPLSYMBOL, ...) into Imprint Layout Notation (ILN).                                                                                                     |

## shared

Small utilities shared by every layer.

| Module                                                          | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`shared/natural-sort.ts`](../src/lib/shared/natural-sort.ts)   | Natural ordering for names that embed quantities ("Levothyroxine 50MCG"): numbers compare by magnitude, and numbers carrying a unit compare by their value in a shared base unit, so 250MCG < 0.5MG < 12.5MG < 1G < 2G.                                                                              |
| [`shared/round-corners.ts`](../src/lib/shared/round-corners.ts) | Softens every sharp corner of an SVG outline: a real tablet is pressed in a die and never has a knife-edge point. Curves are kept exact (arcs and quadratics become cubics); only the joints where the outline turns by more than a few degrees get a short quadratic fillet through the old vertex. |

| [`components/CompoundLineRow.svelte`](../src/lib/components/CompoundLineRow.svelte)                       | One component line of the compound builder: its concentration, amount and volume as quantity fields, and a row menu to remove it. Diluent lines show only a volume. `locked` shows the values read-only.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`components/DosingMeasureForm.svelte`](../src/lib/components/DosingMeasureForm.svelte)                   | A "⋯" popover for choosing a combination product's dosing measure — the sum of its ingredients (or a chosen subset), or one ingredient. The choice is saved for the whole SCD concept through the page's `?/setDosingMeasure` and `?/clearDosingMeasure` actions.                                                                                                                                                         |
| [`components/EquivalenceGroups.svelte`](../src/lib/components/EquivalenceGroups.svelte)                   | Settings editor for equivalence groups: sets of a dimension's values (e.g. dose form spellings) merged and shown under one name. Suggests likely groups from the formulary's values, and edits, saves and deletes groups.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`components/FinalConcentrations.svelte`](../src/lib/components/FinalConcentrations.svelte)               | The "Final concentrations" table of the compound builder: one row per ingredient slot with its resulting amount as a mixed fraction, or a dash while there isn't enough information to work it out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [`components/FormularyIcon.svelte`](../src/lib/components/FormularyIcon.svelte)                           | An open-book icon for a package's formulary status: a check when it is on the formulary, an exclamation mark when it is linked but excluded, a question mark when it is not on it. The label doubles as the accessible name and tooltip.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`components/HierarchyBuilder.svelte`](../src/lib/components/HierarchyBuilder.svelte)                     | Drag-and-drop editor for a formulary hierarchy; each level nests under the one before it. Dimensions are dragged from a palette into the hierarchy as chips, reordered, swapped for a variant (e.g. separated ↔ combined ingredients), or set to absorb an only child.                                                                                                                                                    |
| [`components/IngredientCorrectionDialog.svelte`](../src/lib/components/IngredientCorrectionDialog.svelte) | "Correct ingredient" wizard, in steps: what is wrong (the label names the wrong substance, states the strength as a different substance, or measures it as one it never lists), identify the substance (looked up in GSRS by name or UNII), convert the strength by molecular weight when its basis changes, cite the evidence, and review. The correction is footnoted beside the value, keeping the original.           |
| [`components/IngredientScenarios.svelte`](../src/lib/components/IngredientScenarios.svelte)               | "Ingredient scenarios" for a formulary item: which ingredient profiles (active ingredients and excipients) its packages fall into, as a matrix of profiles against ingredients. Ticking ingredients to avoid shows which NDCs remain. Columns merge salts into their moiety unless listed separately.                                                                                                                     |
| [`components/ItemSummary.svelte`](../src/lib/components/ItemSummary.svelte)                               | "Summary across" a formulary item's packages: composition (ingredients, strengths, excipients), packaging, regulatory facts and sources, each value counted over the packages that carry it. Strengths follow the item's display style.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`components/LabelBlocks.svelte`](../src/lib/components/LabelBlocks.svelte)                               | Renders SPL label content (headings, styled paragraphs, nested lists and tables) as parsed by `labels/spl-sections.ts`. While a citation is being captured, each table row gets a checkbox so it can be cited as its cells' text.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [`components/LocalConceptBlock.svelte`](../src/lib/components/LocalConceptBlock.svelte)                   | The local superseding concept shown on a package: the RxCUI it supersedes, its own name and code, what RxNorm says instead, an ingredient diff against RxNorm when they differ, and any ionic content the label states.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`components/LocalConceptDialog.svelte`](../src/lib/components/LocalConceptDialog.svelte)                 | Editor for a local concept that supersedes RxNorm's for an NDC: its ingredients and strengths, the label's ionic content, and a live diff against RxNorm's concept. Also asks to stop superseding. Posts to the page's `localConceptSave` and `localConceptStop` actions.                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`components/LocalConceptDiff.svelte`](../src/lib/components/LocalConceptDiff.svelte)                     | A local concept's ingredients against RxNorm's: one row per ingredient with RxNorm's strength and the local one, tagged removed, changed or added, and a caption counting each kind of change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`components/MixedFraction.svelte`](../src/lib/components/MixedFraction.svelte)                           | A value set as a mixed number: the whole part at full size, the remainder stacked over its denominator. "131 11/19 mg/mL" says the vial holds 2500 mg in nineteen millilitres; "131.5789473684" says nothing checkable.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`components/OverrideCitation.svelte`](../src/lib/components/OverrideCitation.svelte)                     | The source cited for a manual property override: a URL with its excerpt, an SPL passage (or several) linked to DailyMed, an NDC the value was copied from, or a note that no source was cited.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`components/PackageDetail.svelte`](../src/lib/components/PackageDetail.svelte)                           | Everything known about one package (NDC): its identity, RxNorm concept (or the local concept superseding it), ingredients as a tree of salts, moieties and ions, strengths, packaging and reconstitution, appearance, classes and label. Each value cites the provider it came from; corrections and manual overrides are footnoted with their own marks, and `editing` offers a pencil beside each overridable property. |
| [`components/PageHeader.svelte`](../src/lib/components/PageHeader.svelte)                                 | Every page's header: an eyebrow (breadcrumbs, or a record's kind and code), the title, and the description lines under it, muted and stacked. A title ending in `[Brand]` (RxNorm's form) shows the brand as a superheading over the rest. `compact` sizes the title for a record page (a package, an ingredient, a compound); `actions` sit to the right, wrapping below on narrow screens.                              |
| [`components/PharmClassRuleDialog.svelte`](../src/lib/components/PharmClassRuleDialog.svelte)             | Dialog for pharmacologic class rules: assign a class at a chosen scope (replace the source's classes, add to them, or suppress one), and edit or delete existing rules. Posts to the page's `pharmClassRule` and `pharmClassRuleDelete` actions.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`components/PillMockup.svelte`](../src/lib/components/PillMockup.svelte)                                 | A drawn mockup of a solid oral dose form from its SPL appearance (shape, colors, score, imprint laid out as ILN), front and back side by side, or the label's photo when there is one; clicking switches between them. `compact` drops the caption.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| [`components/PropertyOverridePanel.svelte`](../src/lib/components/PropertyOverridePanel.svelte)           | Panel for overriding one or more of a package's properties by hand: enter the correct value (with shape-, pill- and ingredient-aware editors), cite where it comes from, and see which override it supersedes.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`components/QuantityField.svelte`](../src/lib/components/QuantityField.svelte)                           | One field for every typed quantity — A plain number, a mixed number ("131 11/19"), a percent ("0.9%"), an amount with a unit ("1.5 g"), or a ratio of units ("2500/19 mg/mL", "20,000 UNT/vial", "250 mg/5 mL").                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`components/ReconstitutionDiagram.svelte`](../src/lib/components/ReconstitutionDiagram.svelte)           | Schematic of a dry-fill container after reconstitution, drawn to scale — One linear mL → px scale covers every band, so a 0.4 mL powder displacement under 9.6 mL of diluent looks as thin as it is.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`components/ReinterpretDialog.svelte`](../src/lib/components/ReinterpretDialog.svelte)                   | "Reload & reinterpret" dialog for a package: mark each interpreted value correct, incorrect, incomplete or too broad (saying what is wrong), and direct the scrape — a preferred DailyMed SPL set id, the rows that apply to this package — before its sources are fetched again and read anew.                                                                                                                           |
| [`components/RouteBadge.svelte`](../src/lib/components/RouteBadge.svelte)                                 | A route of administration as its short code (e.g. "IV" for "INTRAVENOUS"), with the full route as the tooltip.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`components/RxCui.svelte`](../src/lib/components/RxCui.svelte)                                           | An RxCUI in monospace with its RxNorm name in a hover/focus tooltip. The name is looked up lazily (and shared across instances) unless the caller already knows it. Renders an em dash when there is no RxCUI.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`components/SplLabelSections.svelte`](../src/lib/components/SplLabelSections.svelte)                     | A package's SPL label as collapsible sections. Given a `scope`, a label shared with other forms or strengths shows only this NDC's passages, with a note saying what was left out.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [`components/SplPassagePicker.svelte`](../src/lib/components/SplPassagePicker.svelte)                     | Lets a person cite passages of the SPL label by selecting text on the page's own label sections (or ticking table rows). Picked passages stay highlighted, survive a section being collapsed and expanded, and are bound back as `passages`.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [`components/StrengthStyleRules.svelte`](../src/lib/components/StrengthStyleRules.svelte)                 | Settings editor for strength display rules: define, edit and remove them. While a rule is drafted, a preview shows how it would restyle the formulary's own products, only where the draft is the rule that wins.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [`components/helpers/MgPerMl.svelte`](../src/lib/components/helpers/MgPerMl.svelte)                       | A concentration in mg/mL, with the unit typeset as a stacked fraction and read aloud as "milligrams per milliliter".                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`components/loading/Bone.svelte`](../src/lib/components/loading/Bone.svelte)                             | One shimmering placeholder block for skeleton screens. Size it with `w`/`h`; `round` makes a pill or circle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| [`components/loading/JobProgress.svelte`](../src/lib/components/loading/JobProgress.svelte)               | Floating panel listing background jobs (refreshes, batch loads) with progress, a time-left estimate and a hint about slow steps. Polls `/api/v1/jobs` quickly while a job runs or a form was just submitted, slowly otherwise, and stops while the tab is hidden and nothing is running. Finished jobs can be dismissed.                                                                                                  |
| [`components/loading/NavProgress.svelte`](../src/lib/components/loading/NavProgress.svelte)               | Slim top bar that creeps toward the end while a navigation is pending, plus a corner spinner.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| [`components/loading/PageSkeleton.svelte`](../src/lib/components/loading/PageSkeleton.svelte)             | Placeholder page shown while a navigation loads, shaped like the destination `kind`. The header is the real thing wherever the destination is already known: static copy, the URL's own params, and the formulary name carried over from the page being left. Only names that need the load (an item, a compound, a labeler) stay as bones, along with everything below the header.                                       |
| [`components/loading/skeleton-route.ts`](../src/lib/components/loading/skeleton-route.ts)                 | Which page skeleton stands in for a destination route while its load runs; unlisted routes just dim.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

## server

Server-only code: providers, catalog persistence and sync, curation stores, media and infrastructure.

| Module                                                                                              | Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`server/catalog/cache.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/cache.ts)                                     | Package cache snapshots: the versioned snapshot written for each package, how long it stays fresh, and reading it back.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`server/catalog/collection.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/collection.ts)                           | Read-through package collection: cached snapshots while fresh, provider enrichment for the rest.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`server/catalog/enrich-packages.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/enrich-packages.ts)                 | Multi-provider package interpretation: openFDA, DailyMed, RxNav and GSRS are asked about a batch of NDCs, and their answers are assembled into packages with their label ingredients, moieties, routes and forms.                                                                         |
| [`server/catalog/entity-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/entity-store.ts)                       | Canonical catalog writes and eligibility reconciliation: persisting a collection's entities, and re-applying the exclusion ladder from stored evidence without provider calls.                                                                                                            |
| [`server/catalog/labeler-packages.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/labeler-packages.ts)               | A labeler's packages: labeler codes, the 10-digit layout each NDC is labeled in (4-4-2, 5-3-2 or 5-4-1), and every cached package under a code.                                                                                                                                           |
| [`server/catalog/package-detail.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/package-detail.ts)                   | Loads everything an NDC page shows about one package.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| [`server/catalog/package-state-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/package-state-store.ts)         | Persisted package state: provider baselines and user decisions, written under a sorted package lock with revision (compare-and-swap) checks so a refresh never overwrites a decision.                                                                                                     |
| [`server/catalog/product-sets.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/product-sets.ts)                       | Curated product sets: formulary items for products RxNorm never links to a concept (Sterile Water for Injection), matched by search and resolved to their package NDCs.                                                                                                                   |
| [`server/catalog/pseudo-scd-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/pseudo-scd-store.ts)               | Persisting pseudo-SCD links: pointing each package at the pseudo-SCD its facts derive, and backfilling links from the latest snapshots.                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`server/catalog/search.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/search.ts)                                   | The search API (`GET /api/v1/search`): local catalog and live RxNav results, ranked, paged and filtered.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`server/catalog/snapshot-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/snapshot-store.ts)                   | The snapshot repository: evidence writes, source hashing, staging, the latest cache record per package or concept, and SBD → SCD lookups from concept snapshots.                                                                                                                          |
| [`server/catalog/sync.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/sync.ts)                                       | Search and load orchestration: read-through collection shared by search and package detail, staged concept trees, and promoting a staged node into the formulary.                                                                                                                         |
| [`server/catalog/unii-usage.ts`](../src/lib/server/catalog/unii-usage.ts)                           | Every cached package that refers to a UNII, and how it refers to it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`server/compounds/store.ts`](../src/lib/server/compounds/store.ts)                                 | Persistence for compounds: create, rename, delete, add and remove components, save lines, and lock a finished compound.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| [`server/curation/dosing-measure-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/dosing-measure-store.ts)     | Persistence for dosing measures, saved per SCD concept so every NDC under it reads the same one.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`server/curation/local-concept-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/local-concept-store.ts)       | Persistence for local superseding concepts: create, update, supersede, stop, retire, list, and open review items when a superseded RxNorm concept drifts.                                                                                                                                 |
| [`server/curation/local-concept-target.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/local-concept-target.ts)     | The RxNorm SCD a local concept defined from an NDC supersedes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`server/curation/local-concept-view.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/local-concept-view.ts)         | Display-time local concepts: items and staged trees annotated with the local concept that supersedes their RxCUI in a scope.                                                                                                                                                              |
| [`server/curation/override-citation.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/override-citation.ts)           | Checking an override's citation against what it cites, and building the overrides a labeler ambiguity implies.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`server/curation/override-propagation.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/override-propagation.ts)     | Passing overrides along: applying them to a package, and copying them to sibling packages of the same product (product-level fields always; unit-of-use fields when the sibling holds the same unit).                                                                                     |
| [`server/curation/package-corrections.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/package-corrections.ts)       | Committing package changes — corrections, review decisions, provenance and cache projections — together, with no provider calls.                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`server/curation/pharm-class-rule-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/pharm-class-rule-store.ts) | Persistence for pharmacologic class rules, counts of the packages each would apply to, and the known source classes offered as type-ahead.                                                                                                                                                |
| [`server/curation/pharm-class-view.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/pharm-class-view.ts)             | Display-time pharmacologic classes: the source's classes with the scope's rules applied, for items and staged trees. Read paths only.                                                                                                                                                     |
| [`server/curation/property-override.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/property-override.ts)           | Saving and removing property overrides, and finding the equivalent packages whose values may stand in for one.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`server/curation/reinterpret.ts`](../src/lib/server/curation/reinterpret.ts)                       | Previewing and applying a "Reload & reinterpret" of one package.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`server/formulary/brand-tag-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/formulary/brand-tag-store.ts)             | Persistence for a formulary item's brand tags.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| [`server/formulary/membership.ts`](../src/lib/server/formulary/membership.ts)                       | Formulary membership and origins: loading a staged node into the catalog and the formulary, which nodes are loaded, and removing or unlinking them.                                                                                                                                       |
| [`server/formulary/read.ts`](../src/lib/server/formulary/read.ts)                                   | Effective formulary rows: every package linked into a scope, flattened with the facts the hierarchy groups by, and each NDC's on/excluded status.                                                                                                                                         |
| [`server/formulary/strength-styles.ts`](../src/lib/server/formulary/strength-styles.ts)             | The strength display rules a formulary scope names its items with.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [`server/infrastructure/database.ts`](../src/lib/server/infrastructure/database.ts)                 | The shared Prisma client, reused across dev-server reloads.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [`server/infrastructure/jobs.ts`](../src/lib/server/infrastructure/jobs.ts)                         | Tracked background jobs: long-running server operations report stages, notes and batch progress that the job overlay polls.                                                                                                                                                               |
| [`server/infrastructure/log.ts`](../src/lib/server/infrastructure/log.ts)                           | Scoped logging filtered by `LOG_LEVEL`, URL redaction for log lines, and a `fetch` that logs every outbound request.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| [`server/media/local-pill-photos.ts`](../src/lib/server/media/local-pill-photos.ts)                 | Pill photos saved by hand, for development — `dev-pill-photos/` holds photos a developer saved themselves, named by NDC (see its README).                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`server/media/pill-image-analyze.ts`](../src/lib/server/media/pill-image-analyze.ts)               | Measuring a label photo — A label's SPLIMAGE is a studio photo: one to three pills, usually both faces of the same tablet, on a flat grey or white backdrop, sometimes with a mm ruler along two edges.                                                                                   |
| [`server/media/pill-image-ocr.ts`](../src/lib/server/media/pill-image-ocr.ts)                       | Tesseract, when it is installed, as the analyzer's crop reader. Optional on purpose: without it the analyzer still places sections by glyph count, which settles every imprint whose sections differ in length, and the binary is a system package rather than something npm can provide. |
| [`server/media/pill-image-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/media/pill-image-store.ts)                   | Measured imprint layouts, stored — Measuring a label photo means a DailyMed fetch, a decode and a few dozen OCR calls — a second or two — so it is done once per photo and kept in `pill_image_layout`.                                                                                   |
| [`server/media/pill-photo.ts`](../src/lib/server/media/pill-photo.ts)                               | Finding a photo for a pill whose snapshot names none — A package snapshot names its label's photo when the label has one and the snapshot was parsed after `SPLIMAGE` was.                                                                                                                |
| [`server/medication/ion-content.ts`](../src/lib/server/medication/ion-content.ts)                   | Ions a package's salts deliver — A sodium salt's sodium is a fact of the salt: its formula says how many Na atoms one unit holds, its molecular weight how much one unit weighs.                                                                                                          |
| [`server/medication/substance-store.ts`](../src/lib/server/medication/substance-store.ts)           | A cached view of GSRS substances by UNII, and the moieties, molecular-weight factors and salt formulas derived from them.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| [`server/providers/cms-billing.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/cms-billing.ts)                     | The CMS Medicare Part B NDC–HCPCS crosswalk (its ASP, OPPS, AWP and PrEP files): kept at the newest quarter CMS has published, and read for each NDC's billing formats. Parsing lives in `catalog/cms-billing.ts`.                                                                        |
| [`server/providers/concurrency.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/concurrency.ts)                     | Ordered, bounded concurrency for provider calls.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| [`server/providers/dailymed.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/dailymed.ts)                           | DailyMed endpoints, and the compliance-inactivation flag only its HTML label page shows.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`server/providers/gsrs.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/gsrs.ts)                                   | FDA's Global Substance Registration System — The ingredient correction wizard converts a strength between two substances by molecular weight, and GSRS is where those weights (and the active moiety of a salt) come from.                                                                |
| [`server/providers/openfda.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/openfda.ts)                             | openFDA endpoints: the NDC directory and drug labels, paged searches, and labeler names.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`server/providers/rxnav.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/rxnav.ts)                                 | RxNav discovery: relationship traversal from a search to concepts and their packages, ranking, facets and concept pages.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [`server/providers/transport.ts`](../src/lib/server/providers/transport.ts)                         | Provider transport: timeouts, shared responses, rate-limit retries, openFDA key rotation, forced-refresh invalidation, and per-source failure reporting.                                                                                                                                  |
| [`server/testing/package-fixture.ts`](../src/lib/server/testing/package-fixture.ts)                 | A complete `ExternalPackage` for tests, with any fields overridden.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## Top level

| Module                                      | Summary                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`rxnorm-tty.ts`](../src/lib/rxnorm-tty.ts) | RxNorm names every concept by a term type (TTY): SCD, SBD, BN, DF… They are precise but opaque, so the search shows a plain name and keeps the code and its meaning in a tooltip. |
